gen-fs-plein-fs-literata: Plein welcomes the eye with open bowls, approachable and modern. Literata holds a classic serif column with sturdy thins; Plein hits hardest in a few big words.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-lexend-exa: Unchanging stroke width and wide-open curves give Lexend Exa a clean, easy read from the first line. Lexend Exa likes a slightly smaller size, while Pramukh Rounded bunches friendly rounds above.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-headland-one: Ebb and flow of stroke thickness marks Quilon, editorial and commanding. And Headland One holds a classic serif column, while Quilon lives in a short, large line.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-alike-angular: Marker-width strokes with daylight in every curve: that's Red Hat Display. Alike Angular holds a serif column, while Red Hat Display hits hardest in a few big words.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-chiron-sung-hk: Constant ink like a marker, daylight in every curve, that's Red Hat Display, contemporary and bold. Chiron Sung HK prefers a smaller size, modulation visible only up close.
gen-gf-anybody-archivo: Flared curve ends that never meet: Anybody, bold and packed toward the caps. Archivo drops a point, a sans-serif with outward curves and a commanding x-height.
gen-gf-anybody-fs-public-sans: Lowercase packed up toward the caps in Anybody, flared ends still apart. Public Sans shrinks a notch, a hefty sans with broad counters on the rounds.
gen-gf-autour-one-noto-serif: A clear channel into each round letter marks Autour One, one-depth cuts with almost matching cases. Noto Serif prefers a smaller size, a faint thick-thin rhythm throughout.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-fs-fira-sans: Bold is the first hit of Baloo Da 2, lowercase almost cap-high. Fira Sans takes a smaller size well, a plain sans with zero thick-thin contrast and a larger x-height.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-manrope: Manrope keeps a bright gap at every curved mouth, one-width strokes and cases almost matching throughout. Baloo Tamma 2 stays commanding above; that sans holds a column without snagging.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-fs-epilogue: Baloo Thambi 2 shows a deep midsection and distinct gaps in the rounds. Epilogue takes a smaller size well, a plain sans with unclamped curves and a wire-like skeleton.
gen-gf-battambang-manrope: Expressive open jaws on every curve mark Battambang, ascenders kept short and distinctive. And Manrope drops a point, a sans-serif with one-width strokes and cases almost matching.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-cascadia-code: Commanding crescent-wrench c shapes mark Baumans, every stroke one thickness, distinctive and wide on the heading. Cascadia Code holds a stretch of plain sans, letters far apart.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-montserrat-alternates: One-stylus strokes, an s whose ends hang far from the spine: Bellota. Montserrat Alternates holds the sans column, while Bellota belongs up top, huge and brief.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-julius-sans-one: Widely spaced letters with open-ended curves and almost matching cases give Julius Sans One a clean, easy read. Julius Sans One prefers a smaller size under Bellota Text, a distinctive display with unshaded strokes.
